plan_review.notes: Alt A separate wave system rejected: violates single phase authority and creates ordering coupling. Alt B ambient director rejected: player-relative spawning cannot provide fixed gates/FIFO debt. Alt C pre-spawn rejected: violates cap. Adopted reviewer revisions: bounded director transition handling, immutable content separate from release state, Floor 4 pack/schema registration and roster validation; retain arenaDirectorSystem and existing scenario slot.

rounds.notes: cutFloor4WaveEnemies cleared waves.debt without counting it, so released entries no longer equalled enemiesSpawned + debtDiscarded. Fixed by adding the banked debt length to debtDiscarded before clearing, plus an accounting-invariant regression test.
Re-review of the delta (throw-on-missing-gate, cut debt accounting, new multi-act/invariant/throw tests) reported no new issues.

claude-sonnet-4.6 raised three: act-relative firesAtArenaMs assertion (arena-absolute in production), unaccounted null spawns, and lost multi-act coverage after the headless VICTORY test was replaced. gpt-5.3-codex and gemini-3.1-pro-preview reported clean and confirmed arenaDirectorSystem is wired via afterSpawnerSystems in src/bootstrap/floor-main-scene-options.ts. All three fixed.

claude-sonnet-4.6 argued a missing feed gate should throw rather than be counted as discarded debt; adjudicator gpt-5.5 agreed (broken map/manifest contract must fail loudly). spawnFloor4WaveEnemy now returns number and throws, with a regression test. gpt-5.3-codex, gemini-3.1-pro-preview and claude-opus-4.6 re-reviewed the delta and reported clean.
